interpretation.exact_luminal_tensor_implication: On the alpha-tuned branch with epsilon nonzero, c13=0 solves r=-1 exactly; this simultaneously gives c14=c123=0, so exact tensor luminality is the degenerate scalar surface rather than a regular two-tensor point.
interpretation.exact_luminal_two_case_split: For the general exact-luminal branch, c14=0 makes the scalar kinetic factor vanish. If c123!=0 the gradient factor remains nonzero, giving an instantaneous/constraint scalar channel; if c123=0 both factors vanish and the scalar principal symbol is rank-degenerate/strongly coupled. Neither case is a regular healthy propagating-free closure.
interpretation.regular_branch: alpha1=alpha2=0 is algebraically tunable and can coexist with c13≈0 and positive/superluminal principal speeds, but every such regular point has a nonzero scalar aether principal symbol; this violates N_grav=2 if that scalar is gravitational.
interpretation.degenerate_branch: c14=0 or c123=0 is not a regular PPN solution; standard speed/PPN formulae lose their denominators and require a separate full Dirac calculation.
